about: Sample input for run_team3.py (Team 3: Acoustic Propagation). Distances in metres, frequencies in Hz, speed in m/s.

run1_team_design.about: The team's own design. These values are read from code/nitk_usoundsim/config.py; they are listed here only so you can see them. run_team3.py checks that they match config.py.

run2_final_probe.about: The project's final probe (Philips L12-4 model). These values are passed as arguments to the team's functions; the team's code is not changed.
